description: Create and configure the Bronze S3 bucket
steps: Create S3 bucket with name following naming convention (e.g., prediction-bronze-{env})
Enable versioning on the bucket
Configure lifecycle rules for cost management (optional: transition to IA after 90 days)
Set up bucket policy restricting access to ECS task role
Enable server-side encryption (SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS)
Document bucket ARN and name in infrastructure notes

description: Create IAM roles and policies for ECS tasks
steps: Create ECS task execution role with ECR and CloudWatch Logs permissions
Create ECS task role with S3 write permissions to Bronze bucket
Add permissions for Secrets Manager if storing API credentials there
Follow least-privilege principle for all policies
Document role ARNs for use in task definitions

description: Create Docker container for ingestion tasks
steps: Create Dockerfile based on python:3.11-slim
Install prediction-data package in container
Configure non-root user for security
Set up health check command
Create ECR repository for container images
Build and push container image to ECR

description: Set up ECS cluster and task definitions
steps: Create ECS cluster named 'prediction-data' (or use existing)
Create parameterized task definition that accepts PLATFORM and ENTITY
Configure Fargate launch type with appropriate CPU/memory (0.25 vCPU, 512MB)
Set up CloudWatch Logs log group: /ecs/prediction-data
Configure task to run prediction-data CLI command
Set appropriate task timeout (10-15 minutes max)

description: Create EventBridge schedules for automated ingestion
steps: Create schedule for Polymarket trades: every 5 minutes
Create schedule for Kalshi trades: every 5 minutes
Create schedule for Polymarket markets: every 1 hour
Create schedule for Kalshi markets: every 1 hour
Configure schedules with timezone America/Chicago
Set up schedule target to run ECS task with correct overrides

description: Set up CloudWatch monitoring and alerting
steps: Create CloudWatch log group with 30-day retention
Create metric filter for error log patterns
Create CloudWatch alarm for task failures
Create alarm for missing runs (no successful run in expected window)
Set up SNS topic for alert notifications
Document alarm ARNs and monitoring procedures
Create infrastructure/ directory for IaC templates
Document all created resources with ARNs and configurations
Create setup script or Terraform/CloudFormation templates (optional)
Document manual setup steps if not using IaC
Include rollback procedures
Create infrastructure diagram showing component relationships
